title: Client Training with a PyTorch Model
learning_objectives: Copy the global model for a client with copy.deepcopy
Train the copy for a few local epochs on the client's data only
Return the client's state_dict and sample count without touching the global model
entry_point: client_update(global_model, X, y, epochs=1, lr=0.1, batch_size=8, seed=0)
hints: `local = copy.deepcopy(global_model)` before anything else touches the weights.
Return `local.state_dict(), len(y)` after the training loop.

failure_feedback.advice: Train copy.deepcopy(global_model), never the global model itself.
Use MSELoss with y reshaped to (n, 1) and SGD with the given lr.
Shuffle with a DataLoader generator seeded with seed.
